subject: maths
question: A can finish a piece of work by working alone in 4 days. B, while working alone, can finish the same work in 12 days. If both of them work together, then in how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

A can finish a piece of work by working alone in 4 days.

B, while working alone, can finish the same work in 12 days.

**Formula used:**

Work rate of A = 1/4

Work rate of B = 1/12

Combined work rate of A and B = (1/4) + (1/12)

**Calculation:**

Combined work rate of A and B = (1/4) + (1/12)

⇒ Combined work rate of A and B = (3/12) + (1/12)

⇒ Combined work rate of A and B = 4/12

⇒
